handbook.birdwatch.little_egret.name: Little Egret
handbook.birdwatch.little_egret.habitat: Habits: Forages slowly along shallow shorelines and mudflats, elegant yet alert; active by day, roosts in trees or reeds at dusk, flies off when startled.
handbook.birdwatch.little_egret.tip: Tip: Ambush riverside shallows while sneaking; alarm distance is about 8 blocks. Use a 200mm+ tele lens from 20m away; focus on the eye and keep shutter at 1/500s or faster to freeze the wingbeat.
handbook.birdwatch.sparrow.name: Tree Sparrow
handbook.birdwatch.sparrow.habitat: Habits: The most common bird in villages and farmlands; gathers in flocks, hops and pecks on the ground, not very shy of people. Active by day, roosts under eaves or in bushes at night.
handbook.birdwatch.sparrow.tip: Tip: Sparrows have a very short alarm distance - a 50mm lens works. Catch them pecking on the ground at 1/250s or faster; sit still by the village entrance and let them come to you.
handbook.birdwatch.tit.name: Great Tit
handbook.birdwatch.tit.habitat: Habits: A lively little bird of forests and woodland edges; hops among canopy branches foraging, sometimes drops to the ground. Active by day with a crisp call.
handbook.birdwatch.tit.tip: Tip: Great Tits never stop hopping in the canopy - use a 200mm+ lens, lock focus and track. Shutter at 1/500s or faster; they are most active at dawn.

bestiary.birdwatch.cow.desc: Docile livestock that graze the plains in herds. A good shot captures pastoral life.
bestiary.birdwatch.sheep.desc: Woolly grazers whose fleece can be sheared. They wander the hills and meadows.
bestiary.birdwatch.pig.desc: Pink livestock that root through the dirt. Pigs napping in the sun are photogenic.
bestiary.birdwatch.chicken.desc: Common poultry that peck around villages and farms. Hens lay eggs, roosters crow.
bestiary.birdwatch.horse.desc: Tall riding animals with many coat variants. Their gallop is graceful.
bestiary.birdwatch.donkey.desc: Stubborn pack animals, shorter than horses, often carrying chests.
bestiary.birdwatch.rabbit.desc: Nimble grazers that bound across plains and taigas. Extremely wary up close.
bestiary.birdwatch.cat.desc: Common mousers in villages with varied coats. Strays are most active at night.
bestiary.birdwatch.wolf.desc: Pack hunters of forests and taigas. Wild wolves are cautious and dangerous.
bestiary.birdwatch.fox.desc: Red-coated nocturnal hunters of forests and taigas. Best seen at dusk and dawn.
bestiary.birdwatch.goat.desc: Mountain climbers that leap across cliffs. They like to headbutt passersby.
bestiary.birdwatch.bat.desc: Nocturnal fliers of caves, using echolocation. They roost upside down by day.
bestiary.birdwatch.parrot.desc: Vivid tropical birds that mimic player speech. They dwell in jungle canopies.
bestiary.birdwatch.axolotl.desc: Smiling water spirits of lush caves. Found in pink, blue, yellow and more.
bestiary.birdwatch.frog.desc: Leaping hunters of wetlands that eat small insects. Temperate, cold and tropical variants.
bestiary.birdwatch.turtle.desc: Slow, leisurely elders of the beach. Hatchlings crawl toward the sea.
bestiary.birdwatch.squid.desc: Soft-bodied sea creatures with ten arms. They ink the dark waters at night.
bestiary.birdwatch.cod.desc: Common cold-water fish that swim in schools. Reliable food for sea travelers.
bestiary.birdwatch.salmon.desc: Anadromous fish that leap waterfalls upstream. They run in rivers during spawning.
bestiary.birdwatch.tropical_fish.desc: Vivid little fish in countless shapes and colors. Coral reefs are their home.
bestiary.birdwatch.zombie.desc: Undead wanderers of the night that fear sunlight. They burn at dawn.
bestiary.birdwatch.skeleton.desc: Precise archers of the night and caves. Bones are their armor.
bestiary.birdwatch.spider.desc: Eight-legged night hunters that scale walls. Watch for their eyes in the dark.
bestiary.birdwatch.creeper.desc: A green creature that creeps close, then explodes. Keep your distance!
screen.birdwatch.bestiary.no_desc: A recorded creature. Habitat notes coming soon.
bestiary.birdwatch.allay.desc: A light blue sprite that follows players who give it a noteblock, collecting dropped items.
bestiary.birdwatch.armadillo.desc: A gentle armored creature that curls into a ball when startled. Its scutes armor wolves.
bestiary.birdwatch.bee.desc: Hardworking pollinators flitting between flowers. Disturb a hive and they swarm.
bestiary.birdwatch.blaze.desc: Blazing guardians of nether fortresses, wreathed in flame. Their fireballs are deadly.
bestiary.birdwatch.breeze.desc: Wind elementals of trial chambers that hurl gusts. Their bodies are made of air and cloud.
bestiary.birdwatch.camel.desc: Tall desert livestock, rideable by two. Their slow gait carries desert rhythm.
bestiary.birdwatch.camel_husk.desc: Undead camels awakened in desert ruins, tall and gaunt.
bestiary.birdwatch.cave_spider.desc: Venomous spiders of caves, smaller but far more poisonous than common ones.
bestiary.birdwatch.dolphin.desc: Friendly spirits of the sea that play with swimmers. They lead travelers to shipwreck treasure.
bestiary.birdwatch.drowned.desc: Drowned zombies haunting oceans and rivers. They throw tridents and sometimes carry nautilus shells.
bestiary.birdwatch.elder_guardian.desc: Ancient rulers of ocean monuments, huge and slow-moving with a gaze that weakens.
bestiary.birdwatch.ender_dragon.desc: The dragon of the End, circling the chorus trees. Defeating it is many adventurers' goal.
bestiary.birdwatch.enderman.desc: Tall black beings of the End. Teleporting and being stared at enrages them. Eye contact is dangerous.
bestiary.birdwatch.endermite.desc: Tiny purple pests left by teleporting endermen. Short-lived and hated by their creators.
bestiary.birdwatch.evoker.desc: Evokers of woodland mansions summon fangs and vexes. They wield dark magic.
bestiary.birdwatch.ghast.desc: Ghostly giants of the Nether with a baby's cry. Their fireballs blast from afar.
bestiary.birdwatch.giant.desc: Ancient giant zombies that exist only in code and legend. They never spawn naturally.
bestiary.birdwatch.glow_squid.desc: Luminous squid of the deep. Their ink glows, bright in the dark.
bestiary.birdwatch.guardian.desc: Guards of ocean monuments with spines and a single eye. Their laser locks onto intruders.
bestiary.birdwatch.hoglin.desc: Savage boars of the crimson forest that attack players. Their meat feeds the Nether.
bestiary.birdwatch.husk.desc: Dried zombies of the desert, immune to sunlight. Their hits bring hunger.
bestiary.birdwatch.illusioner.desc: Illusionists that create decoys and turn invisible. Mysterious and rarely seen.
bestiary.birdwatch.iron_golem.desc: Iron guardians of villages that protect villagers and players. Their fists send foes flying.
bestiary.birdwatch.llama.desc: Highland pack animals that spit at threats. Dressed in carpets, they look proud.
bestiary.birdwatch.magma_cube.desc: Molten slimes of the Nether that split as they bounce. Their bodies glow like hot stone.
bestiary.birdwatch.mooshroom.desc: Mysterious mushroom cows of mushroom islands. A bowl collects their stew.
bestiary.birdwatch.mule.desc: Cross of horse and donkey, unable to breed. Sturdier than either parent.
bestiary.birdwatch.nautilus.desc: Ancient nautilus fossils found in shipwrecks and the deep. Their shells are ocean treasure.
bestiary.birdwatch.ocelot.desc: Wild cats of the jungle, wary and elegant. Fish earn their trust.
bestiary.birdwatch.panda.desc: Black-and-white bears of bamboo groves, lazily munching. Sometimes they roll, sometimes sneeze.
bestiary.birdwatch.phantom.desc: Nightmares of the sleepless, circling the night sky. Nights without rest bring flocks.
bestiary.birdwatch.piglin.desc: Golden folk of the Nether obsessed with gold ingots. Offerings earn gifts; theft enrages them.
bestiary.birdwatch.piglin_brute.desc: Powerful piglins of bastions wielding golden axes. Gold cannot soothe their hostility.
bestiary.birdwatch.pillager.desc: Crossbow raiders roaming near villages in gray hoods, waiting for their moment.
bestiary.birdwatch.polar_bear.desc: Lords of the ice, powerful under white fur. Fierce when protecting cubs.
bestiary.birdwatch.pufferfish.desc: Puffing fish covered in spines. Getting close poisons you.
bestiary.birdwatch.ravager.desc: Beasts of woodland mansions that charge through. Their rampage flattens crops and barricades.
bestiary.birdwatch.shulker.desc: Purple shelled creatures of end cities that fire homing projectiles. Hits make you float.
bestiary.birdwatch.silverfish.desc: Silverfish lurking in stronghold stone, ambushing. Harmed, they call their kin.
bestiary.birdwatch.skeleton_horse.desc: Undead horses born in thunderstorms. They may remain when their riders fall.
bestiary.birdwatch.slime.desc: Green gel of swamps and deep caves that splits into smaller selves. It hops, never flies.
bestiary.birdwatch.sniffer.desc: Ancient sniffers hatched from eggs. They can sniff out buried seeds.
bestiary.birdwatch.snow_golem.desc: Snowmen of snow blocks and pumpkin heads. They pelt foes with snowballs.
bestiary.birdwatch.stray.desc: Frostbitten skeletons of the ice wastes. Their arrows slow you down.
bestiary.birdwatch.strider.desc: Walkers on lava, treading molten ground. Saddle them and steer with fungus on a stick.
bestiary.birdwatch.tadpole.desc: Tadpoles, the young of frogs. They swim and slowly grow legs to become frogs.
bestiary.birdwatch.trader_llama.desc: Pack llamas of wandering traders, decked in colorful cloth. They spit at wolves.
bestiary.birdwatch.vex.desc: Vexes summoned by evokers, small blades sharp, phasing through walls to chase.
bestiary.birdwatch.villager.desc: Villagers who trade goods of every kind. Blacksmiths, farmers, librarians and more.
bestiary.birdwatch.vindicator.desc: Axe-wielding brutes of raiders, guards of woodland mansions.
bestiary.birdwatch.wandering_trader.desc: Traders who walk with two llamas, selling rare exotic goods.
bestiary.birdwatch.warden.desc: Ancient guardians of the deep dark, eyeless, sensing vibration. Their sonic boom pierces walls.
bestiary.birdwatch.witch.desc: Witches of the swamps brewing potions. They throw them at foes and drink to heal.
bestiary.birdwatch.wither.desc: The Wither, born of soul sand and wither skulls. Its heads blast all; it is destruction incarnate.
bestiary.birdwatch.wither_skeleton.desc: Black skeletons of nether fortresses with stone swords. Their strikes wither you.
bestiary.birdwatch.zoglin.desc: Infected piglins, frenzied and mad. They attack anything, even their own kind.
bestiary.birdwatch.zombie_horse.desc: Zombie horses appearing in thunderstorms with skeleton horses. They cannot be tamed.
bestiary.birdwatch.zombie_nautilus.desc: A strange union of drowned and nautilus, drifting slowly in the deep.
bestiary.birdwatch.zombie_villager.desc: Infected villagers with hollow eyes. A splash of weakness and a golden apple cure them.
bestiary.birdwatch.zombified_piglin.desc: Zombified piglins of the Nether, wandering in groups. Strike one, face the mob.
